environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance behind an AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has a basic HTTPS listener forwarding all traffic to the target group on port 8080. No additional rule sets or managed rules are configured on the ALB. The application's session cookie is configured with default Flask settings (SameSite not explicitly set, which defaults to None in older Werkzeug versions). The instance runs Python 3.8 with Werkzeug 1.0.1 and Flask 1.1.2. No reverse proxy or additional middleware is present between ALB and the application.

config.alb_rules: default forward to target group, no WAF attached
